notes: The report opens «قال أبو حازم»: the chain above him is not written, so the first written name is Abu Hazim.
«فسمعني النعمان ... هكذا سمعت سهلا» names Sahl as another transmitter of the same saying: a variant group, never a route (rule 4).
«أنا أشهد على أبي سعيد الخدري لسمعته» : Abu Sa'id is the link Abu Hazim heard, and the saying («إنهم مني») is his.
